column1: # The audit treats the iOS .jl resource as canonical and compares sample BODIES
# across surfaces (iOS .jl / iOS Swift `code:` fallback / mobile .jl). A surface
# that is simply MISSING a sample produces a WARN; a row here suppresses that
# warn and records the omission with a linked Issue. Body MISMATCHES are never
# allowlistable — they always FAIL (fix the surface to match the iOS .jl).
#   id       samples.json id (must exist in the iOS catalog)
#   surface  which surface omits it: mobile | swift
#   issue    #NNNN tracking the decision to add it or keep it omitted
# Web (web/samples_ir.js) stores lowered IR, not raw .jl, and is intentionally
# out of scope for the body-diff gate — it is not represented here.
